{{Quote|Then you'll be returning to beyond shadows with us? I'm sure you'll find it very&mdash;enlightening.|Rhondi Tremaine, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
'''Beyond shadows''' was a mysterious plane of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to which [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] went when they separated their minds from their physical beings. The locations beyond shadows each had a corresponding, real location in the physical [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The technique of separation was practiced by the [[Mind Walkers]] at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw. To go beyond shadows, a being first went into a state of meditation and then pictured one number at a time, beginning with the number one and finishing with seven, which, when pictured, completely severed the being's mind from their body. The sensation felt by Force-sensitives when in beyond shadows was that [[Time/Legends|time]] was nonexistent. Force users in this realm weren't bound by the conceptual frameworks of time and space. Every instant felt as if it lasted forever. As such, it was impossible to keep track of real time while beyond shadows. This made going beyond shadows a dangerous task, as, although the Force could sustain a being's body for a while, the body couldn't live without nutrition forever and thus the being could abruptly [[Death/Legends|die]] while beyond shadows. The Mind Walkers, however, were unconcerned by this fact, as they [[Force psychosis|believed]] that everything was an illusion except for the Force.

After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] went on a five-year sojourn to expand his knowledge of the Force. His journey took him to Sinkhole Station, where he traveled beyond shadows with the Mind Walkers.<ref name="abyss" /><ref name="omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> Later, in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], embarked on a quest to discover more about Solo's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They traveled to Sinkhole Station, where they met with the Mind Walkers. While there, Luke went beyond shadows with Mind Walkers [[Seek Ryontarr]] and [[Feryl]], who showed him the [[Font of Power]] and the [[Pool of Knowledge]]. He was then joined by Ben and another Mind Walker, [[Rhondi Tremaine]], before they traveled to the [[Lake of Apparitions]]. While there, they viewed a [[Abeloth|mysterious being]] who seemed to want to speak with Luke. After conferring with the spirit of Solo in the Lake, however, the Skywalkers realized that they needed to return to their bodies, and they left the realm.<ref name="abyss" /> Later, on Abeloth's planet the Skywalkers Mind Walked with [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|Sith High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Leeha Faal]]<ref name="allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>. Luke Skywalker later returned after the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|Liberation of Coruscant]], where his son and the Sith [[Vestara Khai]] had been taken by Abeloth, along with [[Darth Krayt]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to battle Abeloth, who they defeated with the help of the spirit of Skywalker's deceased wife, [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], while Solo rescued his son and Khai.<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
